newsitem.title: USA: U.S. judge denies request to block Conrail pill.
newsitem.headline: U.S. judge denies request to block Conrail pill.

text.p: A federal judge sitting in Philadelphia has denied a request from Norfolk Southern Corp that sought to block Conrail Inc's poison pill, according to a clerk in the judge's chambers.
U.S. Judge Donald Van Artsdale issued his ruling after an early afternoon hearing, the clerk said.
Norfolk Southern has launched a $9 billion offer to buy Conrail, which last month reached an agreement to be acquired by CSX Corp for $8.4 billion.

Norfolk Southern last week asked the judge to block Conrail from implementing a plan to effectively force its shareholders to accept the CSX offer and prevent them from considering the Norfolk Southern offer.
Norfolk Southern had asked the court to stop Conrail from distributing its poison pill rights on November 7 as part of its antitakeover defense.
Norfolk Southern noted that Conrail and CSX had agreed to delay the rights distribution date, making the request for a temporary restraining order a moot issue.
